svg.title: Derivation map
svg.desc: Eight blocks derive every table from the metric and the orientation of the volume element, in the order of the code: bases with the exterior product and the projective elements, metric, parts, interior products, transwedge, geometric products, norms and properties. Each anti table stands under its base. Each line carries its formula and the function that builds the table.

text.tspan: and 𝐞∞ is in 𝐮■, 𝐮□

svg.text: where 𝐞ᵒ is in 𝐮○, 𝐮□
where k = gr 𝐚 = gr 𝐛
